source.title: Strabane Chronicle, 14 June 1958, p. 2 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Rural District of Strabane, 1958")
source.publisher: Strabane Chronicle (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Strabane Chronicle, 14 June 1958, p. 2, block images read): the only candidate entered for the division, no poll having been taken

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Ballymagorry was contested (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5). The Belfast News-Letter of 21 May 1958, p. 11 also reported a contest in Ardstraw, but the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Strabane Chronicle, 14 June 1958, p. 2) enters a single candidate there; all 28 divisions are recorded from the notice. Printed 'Dunnamanagh'. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Donemana' to Dunnamanagh (19 Nov 2026, w19-merges, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official DED name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Strabane No. 1 Rural District) and the NI DED maps of 1921-39 name the DED Dunnamanagh; the rounds were filed as Donemana (1927, 1930, 1939-67) and Dunamanagh (1924, 1933, 1936). This round was filed as 'Donemana', the spelling of its source, kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (donemana) answers with a redirect to this one.
